topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation within the broader course context.

topics.label: Pathogen- and damage-associated molecular patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the characteristics, criteria, and role of molecular patterns in enabling the innate immune system to detect infection, damage, and non-self entities.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and intracellular signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the genetics, cellular localization, and downstream signaling pathways of pattern recognition receptors, including toll-like receptors and the inflammasome.

topics.label: Cellular inflammatory response, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cell activation directs leukocyte recruitment into tissues, coordinates adaptive immune priming, and can lead to severe systemic consequences like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the mechanisms required to terminate inflammation, coordinate wound healing, and adapt to unresolved or chronic tissue pathology.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture wrap-up and announces the subject of the subsequent lecture.
